headline: 7 token contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Solana, Aptos, SEI, Ink, Avalanche, and Polygon; 1 proxy implementation surfaced on Ethereum; no GitHub or audit PDFs found.

findings.text: D1: Ethereum name-tag search via Etherscan returned the ACRED token proxy at 0x17418038ecF73BA4026c4f428547BF099706F27B and its implementation at 0xFc8a9000c161e3c6e073e967107ce926a44a06e2 (labeled DSToken). Direct block-explorer fetches for non-Ethereum chains (Polygon, Avalanche, Ink, SEI) were blocked by the domain allowlist — addresses obtained via RWA.xyz instead.

D2: protocol.website (securitize.io/primary-market/...) returned a JavaScript-only page with no deployed-contracts listing. No standalone deployments doc was found for ACRED. RWA.xyz served as the effective deployed-contracts listing, providing all 7 chain addresses with contract links.
D3: No audit_links are recorded in the per-protocol context. Etherscan shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted' for the proxy contract. No audit PDF was located in this run.

D4: protocol.github is listed as '(none recorded)'. No GitHub repository was found via search for Securitize/ACRED source code. No deployment artifacts (run-latest.json, deployments.json) were accessible.

D5: All 7 chains enumerated. Ethereum address fetched directly via Etherscan. Solana (FubtUcvhSCr3VPXEcxouoQjKQ7NWTCzXyECe76B7L3f8), Aptos (0xe528f4df568eb9fff6398adc514bc9585fab397f478972bcbebf1e75dee40a88), SEI (0xf7fa6725183e603059fc23d95735bf67f72b2d78), Ink (0x53ad50d3b6fcacb8965d3a49cb722917c7dae1f3), Avalanche (0x7c64925002bfa705834b118a923e9911bee32875), Polygon (0xfce60bbc52a5705cec5b445501fbaf3274dc43d0) surfaced via RWA.xyz. Cross-chain transfers use Wormhole as interoperability provider.

D6: No factory contracts identified. ACRED is a single-token-per-chain deployment model. The article mentions an sACRED derivative token contract (a Securitize-operated staking/wrapper contract) but no address was found for it in this run.

D7: All admin_addresses entries use controlled vocabulary: 'token' for ERC-20/token-2022 deployments; 'other' for the proxy implementation. Actor class set to 'unknown' for all non-Ethereum entries pending bytecode inspection.
D8: All 8 admin_addresses entries trace to either the Etherscan fetch (Ethereum proxy + implementation) or the RWA.xyz fetch (all 7 chain token addresses). No snippet-only sightings.

rationale.verdict: 7 token contract addresses catalogued across all 7 protocol chains from direct Etherscan fetch (Ethereum) and RWA.xyz verified listing (all chains). Ethereum proxy structure (ERC-1967 Transparent Proxy + DSToken implementation) confirmed on-chain. No GitHub repo, no audit PDFs, and no admin/multisig/timelock addresses identified — owner() and proxy admin reads could not be performed because the DeFiPunkd API domain is allowlist-blocked and Etherscan address pages were also blocked for sub-pages beyond the token page.

evidence.shows: ACRED Ethereum token is an ERC-1967 Transparent Proxy at 0x17418038ecF73BA4026c4f428547BF099706F27B with implementation at 0xFc8a9000c161e3c6e073e967107ce926a44a06e2 (DSToken); max total supply ~37,238 ACRED; 6 decimals; upgraded once on 2025-01-29 (block 21731049)

Complete multi-chain token contract table: Ethereum 0x17418038ecf73ba4026c4f428547bf099706f27b (ERC-20), Solana FubtUcvhSCr3VPXEcxouoQjKQ7NWTCzXyECe76B7L3f8 (token-2022), Aptos 0xe528f4df568eb9fff6398adc514bc9585fab397f478972bcbebf1e75dee40a88 (Aptos-Coin), SEI 0xf7fa6725183e603059fc23d95735bf67f72b2d78 (ERC-20), Ink 0x53ad50d3b6fcacb8965d3a49cb722917c7dae1f3 (ERC-20), Avalanche 0x7c64925002bfa705834b118a923e9911bee32875 (ERC-20), Polygon 0xfce60bbc52a5705cec5b445501fbaf3274dc43d0 (ERC-20). Service providers: Manager=Securitize Capital, Sub-Advisor=Apollo Global Management, Custodian=BNY Mellon, Fund Administrator=Securitize, Transfer Agent=Securitize, Auditor=WithumSmith+Brown. Total AUM ~$114M.

protocol_metadata.about: Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund (ACRED) is a tokenized feeder fund, structured as Securitize Tokenized Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, Ltd. (BVI), that channels investor capital into Apollo Diversified Credit Fund — a non-traded, closed-end interval fund investing across corporate direct lending, asset-backed lending, and performing, dislocated, and structured credit. Accredited investors subscribe via Securitize Markets (min. $50,000 USD) and receive ACRED tokens representing their economic interest, with Securitize acting as digital transfer agent and fund administrator, and BNY Mellon as custodian. Tokens are issued natively on seven chains (Ethereum, Solana, Aptos, SEI, Ink, Avalanche, Polygon) with Wormhole providing cross-chain interoperability, and a derivative sACRED wrapper enables holders to participate in DeFi protocols while maintaining their fund exposure.
